verses.original: נַחֲמ֥וּ נַחֲמ֖וּ עַמִּ֑י יֹאמַ֖ר אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: na·ḥă·mū na·ḥă·mū ‘am·mî yō·mar ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem
verses.literal: Comfort comfort My people says your God
verses.literalPt: CONSOLAI, consolai o meu povo, diz o vosso Deus.

verses.original: דַּבְּר֞וּ עַל־ לֵ֤ב יְרֽוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ וְקִרְא֣וּ אֵלֶ֔יהָ כִּ֤י מָֽלְאָה֙ צְבָאָ֔הּ כִּ֥י נִרְצָ֖ה עֲוֺנָ֑הּ כִּ֤י לָקְחָה֙ מִיַּ֣ד יְהוָ֔ה כִּפְלַ֖יִם בְּכָל־ חַטֹּאתֶֽיהָ׃ס
verses.transliteration: dab·bə·rū ‘al- lêḇ yə·rū·šā·lim wə·qir·’ū ’ê·le·hā kî mā·lə·’āh ṣə·ḇā·’āh kî nir·ṣāh ‘ă·wō·nāh kî lā·qə·ḥāh mî·yaḏ Yah·weh kip̄·la·yim bə·ḵāl ḥaṭ·ṭō·ṯe·hā
verses.literal: Speak tenderly to . . . Jerusalem and proclaim to her that her forced labor has been completed her iniquity . . . has been pardoned For she has received from the hand of the LORD double for all her sins
verses.literalPt: Falai benignamente a Jerusalém, e bradai-lhe que já a sua milícia é acabada, que a sua iniqüidade está expiada e que já recebeu em dobro da mão do SENHOR, por todos os seus pecados.

verses.original: ק֣וֹל קוֹרֵ֔א בַּמִּדְבָּ֕ר פַּנּ֖וּ דֶּ֣רֶךְ יְהוָ֑ה יַשְּׁרוּ֙ בָּעֲרָבָ֔ה מְסִלָּ֖ה לֵאלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: qō·wl qō·w·rê bam·miḏ·bār pan·nū de·reḵ Yah·weh yaš·šə·rū bā·‘ă·rā·ḇāh mə·sil·lāh lê·lō·hê·nū
verses.literal: A voice of one calling Prepare the way for the LORD in the wilderness make a straight highway for our God in the desert
verses.literalPt: Voz do que clama no deserto: Preparai o caminho do SENHOR; endireitai no ermo vereda a nosso Deus.

verses.original: כָּל־ גֶּיא֙ יִנָּשֵׂ֔א וְכָל־ הַ֥ר וְגִבְעָ֖ה יִשְׁפָּ֑לוּ וְהָיָ֤ה הֶֽעָקֹב֙ לְמִישׁ֔וֹר וְהָרְכָסִ֖ים לְבִקְעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- ge yin·nā·śê wə·ḵāl har wə·ḡiḇ·‘āh yiš·pā·lū wə·hā·yāh he·‘ā·qōḇ lə·mî·šō·wr wə·hā·rə·ḵā·sîm lə·ḇiq·‘āh
verses.literal: Every valley shall be lifted up and every mountain and hill made low the uneven ground will become smooth and the rugged land a plain
verses.literalPt: Todo o vale será exaltado, e todo o monte e todo o outeiro será abatido; e o que é torcido se endireitará, e o que é áspero se aplainará.

verses.original: וְנִגְלָ֖ה כְּב֣וֹד יְהוָ֑ה וְרָא֤וּ כָל־ בָּשָׂר֙ יַחְדָּ֔ו כִּ֛י פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבֵּֽר׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·niḡ·lāh kə·ḇō·wḏ Yah·weh wə·rā·’ū ḵāl bā·śār yaḥ·dāw kî pî Yah·weh dib·bêr
verses.literal: And the glory of the LORD will be revealed and all humanity together will see it For the mouth of the LORD has spoken
verses.literalPt: E a glória do SENHOR se manifestará, e toda a carne juntamente a verá, pois a boca do SENHOR o disse.

verses.original: ק֚וֹל אֹמֵ֣ר קְרָ֔א וְאָמַ֖ר מָ֣ה אֶקְרָ֑א כָּל־ הַבָּשָׂ֣ר חָצִ֔יר וְכָל־ חַסְדּ֖וֹ כְּצִ֥יץ הַשָּׂדֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: qō·wl ’ō·mêr qə·rā wə·’ā·mar māh ’eq·rā kāl- hab·bā·śār ḥā·ṣîr wə·ḵāl ḥas·dōw kə·ṣîṣ haś·śā·ḏeh
verses.literal: A voice says Cry out And I asked What should I cry out All flesh is like grass and all its glory like the flowers of the field
verses.literalPt: Uma voz diz: Clama; e alguém disse: Que hei de clamar? Toda a carne é erva e toda a sua beleza como a flor do campo.

verses.original: יָבֵ֤שׁ חָצִיר֙ נָ֣בֵֽל צִ֔יץ כִּ֛י ר֥וּחַ יְהוָ֖ה נָ֣שְׁבָה בּ֑וֹ אָכֵ֥ן חָצִ֖יר הָעָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: yā·ḇêš ḥā·ṣîr nā·ḇêl ṣîṣ kî rū·aḥ Yah·weh nā·šə·ḇāh bōw ’ā·ḵên ḥā·ṣîr hā·‘ām
verses.literal: The grass withers and the flowers fall when the breath of the LORD blows on them indeed the people are grass
verses.literalPt: Seca-se a erva, e cai a flor, soprando nela o Espírito do SENHOR. Na verdade o povo é erva.

verses.original: יָבֵ֥שׁ חָצִ֖יר נָ֣בֵֽל צִ֑יץ וּדְבַר־ אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ יָק֥וּם לְעוֹלָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: yā·ḇêš ḥā·ṣîr nā·ḇêl ṣîṣ ū·ḏə·ḇar- ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū yā·qūm lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: The grass withers and the flowers fall but the word of our God stands forever
verses.literalPt: Seca-se a erva, e cai a flor, porém a palavra de nosso Deus subsiste eternamente.

verses.original: עַ֣ל הַר־ גָּבֹ֤הַ עֲלִי־ לָךְ֙ מְבַשֶּׂ֣רֶת צִיּ֔וֹן הָרִ֤ימִי בַכֹּ֙חַ֙ קוֹלֵ֔ךְ מְבַשֶּׂ֖רֶת יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם הָרִ֙ימִי֙ אַל־ תִּירָ֔אִי אִמְרִי֙ לְעָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה הִנֵּ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al har- gā·ḇō·ha ‘ă·lî- lāḵ mə·ḇaś·śe·reṯ ṣî·yō·wn hā·rî·mî ḇak·kō·aḥ qō·w·lêḵ mə·ḇaś·śe·reṯ yə·rū·šā·lim hā·rî·mî ’al- tî·rā·’î ’im·rî lə·‘ā·rê yə·hū·ḏāh hin·nêh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem
verses.literal: Go up on a high mountain O Zion herald of good news Raise your voice loudly . . . O Jerusalem herald of good news Lift it up do not be afraid Say to the cities of Judah Here is your God
verses.literalPt: Tu, ó Sião, que anuncias boas novas, sobe a um monte alto. Tu, ó Jerusalém, que anuncias boas novas, levanta a tua voz fortemente; levanta-a, não temas, e dize às cidades de Judá: Eis aqui está o vosso Deus.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֨ה אֲדֹנָ֤י יְהוִה֙ בְּחָזָ֣ק יָב֔וֹא וּזְרֹע֖וֹ מֹ֣שְׁלָה ל֑וֹ הִנֵּ֤ה שְׂכָרוֹ֙ אִתּ֔וֹ וּפְעֻלָּת֖וֹ לְפָנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh bə·ḥā·zāq yā·ḇō·w ū·zə·rō·‘ōw mō·šə·lāh lōw hin·nêh śə·ḵā·rōw ’it·tōw ū·p̄ə·‘ul·lā·ṯōw lə·p̄ā·nāw
verses.literal: Behold the Lord GOD comes with might and His arm establishes His rule . . . His reward is with Him and His recompense accompanies Him
verses.literalPt: Eis que o Senhor DEUS virá com poder e seu braço dominará por ele; eis que o seu galardão está com ele, e o seu salário diante da sua face.

verses.original: כְּרֹעֶה֙ עֶדְר֣וֹ יִרְעֶ֔ה בִּזְרֹעוֹ֙ יְקַבֵּ֣ץ טְלָאִ֔ים וּבְחֵיק֖וֹ יִשָּׂ֑א עָל֖וֹת יְנַהֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: kə·rō·‘eh ‘eḏ·rōw yir·‘eh biz·rō·‘ōw yə·qab·bêṣ ṭə·lā·’îm ū·ḇə·ḥê·qōw yiś·śā ‘ā·lō·wṯ yə·na·hêl
verses.literal: He tends His flock like a shepherd He gathers the lambs in His arms and carries them close to His heart He gently leads the nursing ewes
verses.literalPt: Como pastor apascentará o seu rebanho; entre os seus braços recolherá os cordeirinhos, e os levará no seu regaço; as que amamentam guiará suavemente.

verses.original: מִֽי־ מָדַ֨ד בְּשָׁעֳל֜וֹ מַ֗יִם וְשָׁמַ֙יִם֙ בַּזֶּ֣רֶת תִּכֵּ֔ן וְכָ֥ל בַּשָּׁלִ֖שׁ עֲפַ֣ר הָאָ֑רֶץ וְשָׁקַ֤ל בַּפֶּ֙לֶס֙ הָרִ֔ים וּגְבָע֖וֹת בְּמֹאזְנָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: mî- mā·ḏaḏ bə·šā·‘o·lōw ma·yim wə·šā·ma·yim baz·ze·reṯ tik·kên wə·ḵāl baš·šā·liš ‘ă·p̄ar hā·’ā·reṣ wə·šā·qal bap·pe·les hā·rîm ū·ḡə·ḇā·‘ō·wṯ bə·mō·zə·nā·yim
verses.literal: Who has measured the waters in the hollow of his hand or marked off the heavens with the span of his hand? Who has held the dust of the earth in a basket or weighed the mountains on a scale and the hills with a balance
verses.literalPt: Quem mediu na concha da sua mão as águas, e tomou a medida dos céus aos palmos, e recolheu numa medida o pó da terra e pesou os montes com peso e os outeiros em balanças?

verses.original: מִֽי־ תִכֵּ֥ן אֶת־ ר֖וּחַ יְהוָ֑ה וְאִ֥ישׁ עֲצָת֖וֹ יוֹדִיעֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: mî- ṯik·kên ’eṯ- rū·aḥ Yah·weh wə·’îš ‘ă·ṣā·ṯōw yō·w·ḏî·‘en·nū
verses.literal: Who has directed the Spirit of the LORD . . . or informed Him as His counselor
verses.literalPt: Quem guiou o Espírito do SENHOR, ou como seu conselheiro o ensinou?

verses.original: אֶת־ מִ֤י נוֹעָץ֙ וַיְבִינֵ֔הוּ וַֽיְלַמְּדֵ֖הוּ בְּאֹ֣רַח מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וַיְלַמְּדֵ֣הוּ דַ֔עַת וְדֶ֥רֶךְ תְּבוּנ֖וֹת יוֹדִיעֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- mî nō·w·‘āṣ way·ḇî·nê·hū way·lam·mə·ḏê·hū bə·’ō·raḥ miš·pāṭ way·lam·mə·ḏê·hū ḏa·‘aṯ wə·ḏe·reḵ tə·ḇū·nō·wṯ yō·w·ḏî·‘en·nū
verses.literal: Whom did He consult . . . to enlighten Him and who taught Him the paths of justice Who imparted knowledge to Him and showed Him the way of understanding
verses.literalPt: Com quem tomou ele conselho, que lhe desse entendimento, e lhe ensinasse o caminho do juízo, e lhe ensinasse conhecimento, e lhe mostrasse o caminho do entendimento?

verses.original: הֵ֤ן גּוֹיִם֙ כְּמַ֣ר מִדְּלִ֔י וּכְשַׁ֥חַק מֹאזְנַ֖יִם נֶחְשָׁ֑בוּ הֵ֥ן אִיִּ֖ים כַּדַּ֥ק יִטּֽוֹל׃
verses.transliteration: hên gō·w·yim kə·mar mid·də·lî ū·ḵə·ša·ḥaq mō·zə·na·yim neḥ·šā·ḇū hên ’î·yîm kad·daq yiṭ·ṭō·wl
verses.literal: Surely the nations are like a drop in a bucket they are considered . . . a speck of dust on the scales He lifts up the islands like fine dust
verses.literalPt: Eis que as nações são consideradas por ele como a gota de um balde, e como o pó miúdo das balanças; eis que ele levanta as ilhas como a uma coisa pequeníssima.

verses.original: וּלְבָנ֕וֹן אֵ֥ין דֵּ֖י בָּעֵ֑ר וְחַיָּת֔וֹ אֵ֥ין דֵּ֖י עוֹלָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·ḇā·nō·wn ’ên dê bā·‘êr wə·ḥay·yā·ṯōw ’ên dê ‘ō·w·lāh
verses.literal: Lebanon is not sufficient for fuel nor its animals . . . enough for a burnt offering
verses.literalPt: Nem todo o Líbano basta para o fogo, nem os seus animais bastam para holocaustos.

verses.original: כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִ֖ם כְּאַ֣יִן נֶגְדּ֑וֹ מֵאֶ֥פֶס וָתֹ֖הוּ נֶחְשְׁבוּ־ לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- hag·gō·w·yim kə·’a·yin neḡ·dōw mê·’e·p̄es wā·ṯō·hū neḥ·šə·ḇū- lōw
verses.literal: All the nations are as nothing before Him He regards them as nothingness and emptiness
verses.literalPt: Todas as nações são como nada perante ele; ele as considera menos do que nada e como uma coisa vã.

verses.original: וְאֶל־ מִ֖י תְּדַמְּי֣וּן אֵ֑ל וּמַה־ דְּמ֖וּת תַּ֥עַרְכוּ לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’el- mî tə·ḏam·mə·yūn ’êl ū·mah- də·mūṯ ta·‘ar·ḵū lōw
verses.literal: To whom will you liken God To what image will you compare Him
verses.literalPt: A quem, pois, fareis semelhante a Deus, ou com que o comparareis?

verses.original: הַפֶּ֙סֶל֙ נָסַ֣ךְ חָרָ֔שׁ וְצֹרֵ֖ף בַּזָּהָ֣ב יְרַקְּעֶ֑נּוּ וּרְתֻק֥וֹת כֶּ֖סֶף צוֹרֵֽף׃
verses.transliteration: hap·pe·sel nā·saḵ ḥā·rāš wə·ṣō·rêp̄ baz·zā·hāḇ yə·raq·qə·‘en·nū ū·rə·ṯu·qō·wṯ ke·sep̄ ṣō·w·rêp̄
verses.literal: To an idol that a craftsman casts and a metalworker overlays with gold and fits with silver chains
verses.literalPt: O artífice funde a imagem, e o ourives a cobre de ouro, e forja para ela cadeias de prata.

verses.original: הַֽמְסֻכָּ֣ן תְּרוּמָ֔ה עֵ֥ץ לֹֽא־ יִרְקַ֖ב יִבְחָ֑ר חָרָ֤שׁ חָכָם֙ יְבַקֶּשׁ־ ל֔וֹ לְהָכִ֥ין פֶּ֖סֶל לֹ֥א יִמּֽוֹט׃
verses.transliteration: ham·suk·kān tə·rū·māh ‘êṣ lō- yir·qaḇ yiḇ·ḥār ḥā·rāš ḥā·ḵām yə·ḇaq·qeš- lōw lə·hā·ḵîn pe·sel lō yim·mō·wṭ
verses.literal: One lacking such an offering chooses wood that will not rot He seeks a skilled craftsman to set up an idol that will not topple
verses.literalPt: O empobrecido, que não pode oferecer tanto, escolhe madeira que não se apodrece; artífice sábio busca, para gravar uma imagem que não se pode mover.

verses.original: הֲל֤וֹא תֵֽדְעוּ֙ הֲל֣וֹא תִשְׁמָ֔עוּ הֲל֛וֹא הֻגַּ֥ד מֵרֹ֖אשׁ לָכֶ֑ם הֲלוֹא֙ הֲבִ֣ינֹתֶ֔ם מוֹסְד֖וֹת הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō·w ṯê·ḏə·‘ū hă·lō·w ṯiš·mā·‘ū hă·lō·w hug·gaḏ mê·rōš lā·ḵem hă·lō·w hă·ḇî·nō·ṯem mō·ws·ḏō·wṯ hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Do you not know Have you not heard Has it not been declared to you from the beginning Have you not understood since the foundation of the earth
verses.literalPt: Porventura não sabeis? Porventura não ouvis, ou desde o princípio não se vos notificou, ou não atentastes para os fundamentos da terra?

verses.original: הַיֹּשֵׁב֙ עַל־ ח֣וּג הָאָ֔רֶץ וְיֹשְׁבֶ֖יהָ כַּחֲגָבִ֑ים הַנּוֹטֶ֤ה כַדֹּק֙ שָׁמַ֔יִם וַיִּמְתָּחֵ֥ם כָּאֹ֖הֶל לָשָֽׁבֶת׃
verses.transliteration: hay·yō·šêḇ ‘al- ḥūḡ hā·’ā·reṣ wə·yō·šə·ḇe·hā ka·ḥă·ḡā·ḇîm han·nō·w·ṭeh ḵad·dōq šā·ma·yim way·yim·tā·ḥêm kā·’ō·hel lā·šā·ḇeṯ
verses.literal: He sits enthroned above the circle of the earth its dwellers are like grasshoppers He stretches out the heavens like a curtain and spreads them out like a tent to dwell in
verses.literalPt: Ele é o que está assentado sobre o círculo da terra, cujos moradores são para ele como gafanhotos; é ele o que estende os céus como cortina, e os desenrola como tenda, para neles habitar;

verses.original: הַנּוֹתֵ֥ן רוֹזְנִ֖ים לְאָ֑יִן שֹׁ֥פְטֵי אֶ֖רֶץ כַּתֹּ֥הוּ עָשָֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: han·nō·w·ṯên rō·wz·nîm lə·’ā·yin šō·p̄ə·ṭê ’e·reṣ kat·tō·hū ‘ā·śāh
verses.literal: He brings the princes to nothing and makes the rulers of the earth meaningless
verses.literalPt: O que reduz a nada os príncipes, e torna em coisa vã os juízes da terra.

verses.original: אַ֣ף בַּל־ נִטָּ֗עוּ אַ֚ף בַּל־ זֹרָ֔עוּ אַ֛ף בַּל־ שֹׁרֵ֥שׁ בָּאָ֖רֶץ גִּזְעָ֑ם וְגַם־ נָשַׁ֤ף בָּהֶם֙ וַיִּבָ֔שׁוּ וּסְעָרָ֖ה כַּקַּ֥שׁ תִּשָּׂאֵֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ap̄ bal- niṭ·ṭā·‘ū ’ap̄ bal- zō·rā·‘ū ’ap̄ bal- šō·rêš bā·’ā·reṣ giz·‘ām wə·ḡam- nā·šap̄ bā·hem way·yi·ḇā·šū ū·sə·‘ā·rāh kaq·qaš tiś·śā·’êm
verses.literal: No sooner . . . are they planted no sooner . . . are they sown no sooner . . . have their stems taken root in the ground than He blows on them and they wither and a whirlwind sweeps them away like stubble
verses.literalPt: E mal se tem plantado, mal se tem semeado, e mal se tem arraigado na terra o seu tronco, já se secam, quando ele sopra sobre eles, e um tufão os leva como a pragana.

verses.original: וְאֶל־ מִ֥י תְדַמְּי֖וּנִי וְאֶשְׁוֶ֑ה יֹאמַ֖ר קָדֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’el- mî ṯə·ḏam·mə·yū·nî wə·’eš·weh yō·mar qā·ḏō·wōš
verses.literal: To whom will you liken Me or who is My equal asks the Holy One
verses.literalPt: A quem, pois, me fareis semelhante, para que eu lhe seja igual? diz o Santo.

verses.original: שְׂאוּ־ מָר֨וֹם עֵינֵיכֶ֤ם וּרְאוּ֙ מִי־ בָרָ֣א אֵ֔לֶּה הַמּוֹצִ֥יא בְמִסְפָּ֖ר צְבָאָ֑ם לְכֻלָּם֙ בְּשֵׁ֣ם יִקְרָ֔א מֵרֹ֤ב אוֹנִים֙ וְאַמִּ֣יץ כֹּ֔חַ אִ֖ישׁ לֹ֥א נֶעְדָּֽר׃ס
verses.transliteration: śə·’ū- mā·rō·wm ‘ê·nê·ḵem ū·rə·’ū mî- ḇā·rā ’êl·leh ham·mō·w·ṣî ḇə·mis·pār ṣə·ḇā·’ām lə·ḵul·lām bə·šêm yiq·rā mê·rōḇ ’ō·w·nîm wə·’am·mîṣ kō·aḥ ’îš lō ne‘·dār
verses.literal: Lift up your eyes on high Who created all these He leads forth the starry host by number He calls each one by name Because of His great power and mighty strength not one of them is missing
verses.literalPt: Levantai ao alto os vossos olhos, e vede quem criou estas coisas; foi aquele que faz sair o exército delas segundo o seu número; ele as chama a todas pelos seus nomes; por causa da grandeza das suas forças, e porquanto é forte em poder, nenhuma delas faltará.

verses.original: לָ֤מָּה תֹאמַר֙ יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב וּתְדַבֵּ֖ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל נִסְתְּרָ֤ה דַרְכִּי֙ מֵֽיְהוָ֔ה וּמֵאֱלֹהַ֖י מִשְׁפָּטִ֥י יַעֲבֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: lām·māh ṯō·mar ya·‘ă·qōḇ ū·ṯə·ḏab·bêr yiś·rā·’êl nis·tə·rāh ḏar·kî Yah·weh ū·mê·’ĕ·lō·hay miš·pā·ṭî ya·‘ă·ḇō·wr
verses.literal: Why do you say O Jacob and why do you assert O Israel My way is hidden from the LORD and my claim is ignored by my God
verses.literalPt: Por que dizes, ó Jacó, e tu falas, ó Israel: O meu caminho está encoberto ao SENHOR, e o meu juízo passa despercebido ao meu Deus?

verses.original: הֲל֨וֹא יָדַ֜עְתָּ אִם־ לֹ֣א שָׁמַ֗עְתָּ אֱלֹהֵ֨י עוֹלָ֤ם׀ יְהוָה֙ בּוֹרֵא֙ קְצ֣וֹת הָאָ֔רֶץ לֹ֥א יִיעַ֖ף וְלֹ֣א יִיגָ֑ע אֵ֥ין חֵ֖קֶר לִתְבוּנָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō·w yā·ḏa‘·tā ’im- lō šā·ma‘·tā ’ĕ·lō·hê ‘ō·w·lām Yah·weh bō·w·rê qə·ṣō·wṯ hā·’ā·reṣ lō yî·‘ap̄ wə·lō yî·ḡā‘ ’ên ḥê·qer liṯ·ḇū·nā·ṯōw
verses.literal: Do you not know . . . Have you not heard The LORD is the everlasting God the Creator of the ends of the earth He will not grow tired . . . or weary His understanding is beyond searching out
verses.literalPt: Não sabes, não ouviste que o eterno Deus, o SENHOR, o Criador dos fins da terra, nem se cansa nem se fatiga? É inescrutável o seu entendimento.

verses.original: נֹתֵ֥ן לַיָּעֵ֖ף כֹּ֑חַ וּלְאֵ֥ין אוֹנִ֖ים עָצְמָ֥ה יַרְבֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: nō·ṯên lay·yā·‘êp̄ kō·aḥ ū·lə·’ên ’ō·w·nîm ‘ā·ṣə·māh yar·beh
verses.literal: He gives power to the faint and increases the strength of the weak . . .
verses.literalPt: Dá força ao cansado, e multiplica as forças ao que não tem nenhum vigor.

verses.original: וְיִֽעֲפ֥וּ נְעָרִ֖ים וְיִגָ֑עוּ וּבַחוּרִ֖ים כָּשׁ֥וֹל יִכָּשֵֽׁלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yi·‘ă·p̄ū nə·‘ā·rîm wə·yi·ḡā·‘ū ū·ḇa·ḥū·rîm kā·šō·wl yik·kā·šê·lū
verses.literal: Even youths grow tired and weary and young men stumble and fall
verses.literalPt: Os jovens se cansarão e se fatigarão, e os moços certamente cairão;

verses.original: וְקוֹיֵ֤ יְהוָה֙ יַחֲלִ֣יפוּ כֹ֔חַ יַעֲל֥וּ אֵ֖בֶר כַּנְּשָׁרִ֑ים יָר֙וּצוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א יִיגָ֔עוּ יֵלְכ֖וּ וְלֹ֥א יִיעָֽפוּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·qō·w·yê Yah·weh ya·ḥă·lî·p̄ū ḵō·aḥ ya·‘ă·lū ’ê·ḇer kan·nə·šā·rîm yā·rū·ṣū wə·lō yî·ḡā·‘ū yê·lə·ḵū wə·lō yî·‘ā·p̄ū
verses.literal: But those who wait upon the LORD will renew their strength they will mount up with wings like eagles they will run and not grow weary they will walk and not faint
verses.literalPt: Mas os que esperam no SENHOR renovarão as forças, subirão com asas como águias; correrão, e não se cansarão; caminharão, e não se fatigarão.
